Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 44, "heading": "CHAPTER 42. MISCHIEF", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u044-b0094", "target": "— Были, одно время, несомненно, — сказал мистер Уикфилд. — Я... да простит меня Бог... я думал, что они были у ВАС.", "source_sha256": "80311ae0b963773f1e8c6b5e7802dd28ddf513bfd498898645610d9efc78f49f", "target_id": "ru-en85-u044-b0094", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a83ab44e617dc66b1ee62d665d2f79f264ec6e51ac3dcbe8b88219ec5012ed43"}, {"source_id": "en85-u044-b0095", "target": "— Нет, нет, нет! — отозвался доктор тоном глубочайшей скорби. — Я думал одно время, — сказал мистер Уикфилд, — что вы хотите отправить Мэлдона за границу, чтобы произвести желательную разлуку.", "source_sha256": "ac687e73077005756db6bd88db1dc16f97025deb5b9cc1777a792aedb2dd40f7", "target_id": "ru-en85-u044-b0095", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "68d555d43c15e72aa529340edda7d49f6ab61b5cf1b0d180e1c2ef185f003983"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 42, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u044-b0096", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, no, no!’ returned the Doctor. ‘To give Annie pleasure, by making some provision for the companion of her childhood. Nothing else.’", "sha256": "fa92cc1a723618035924d82b6353e4c059767ce452c00f89057fbff8b54188b6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[96]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0097", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘So I found,’ said Mr. Wickfield. ‘I couldn’t doubt it, when you told me so. But I thought—I implore you to remember the narrow construction which has been my besetting sin—that, in a case where there was so much disparity in point of years—’", "sha256": "94ae23969d104a12e8603c3d0af03c836e36751c4e8dc2534aef3a4e16cf2727", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[97]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0098", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That’s the way to put it, you see, Master Copperfield!’ observed Uriah, with fawning and offensive pity.", "sha256": "b424b5e755d752f5fa94112f3d7cba2b9c0a09a62f594de2cf70976dceff65c9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[98]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0099", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘—a lady of such youth, and such attractions, however real her respect for you, might have been influenced in marrying, by worldly considerations only. I make no allowance for innumerable feelings and circumstances that may have all tended to good. For Heaven’s sake remember that!’", "sha256": "99ef30f20bc97836a730817b4281887434f62eab3fef71b3f9a7330531ce90fe", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[99]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0100", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘How kind he puts it!’ said Uriah, shaking his head.", "sha256": "f7bd0341cfb8cd0cd27b027a0a906d6f46fbd65c404961bbc5f8c3df20c17fca", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[100]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0101", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Always observing her from one point of view,’ said Mr. Wickfield; ‘but by all that is dear to you, my old friend, I entreat you to consider what it was; I am forced to confess now, having no escape-’", "sha256": "827de090de2ecf9894eaa019421eac2c1932f97c55cbf820be3289945a6466cd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[101]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0102", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No! There’s no way out of it, Mr. Wickfield, sir,’ observed Uriah, ‘when it’s got to this.’", "sha256": "90ac963db50dfdd8463873fc31a9480d842aa27ba3baf1ecdff3e9f02f4bbe81", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[102]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0103", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘—that I did,’ said Mr. Wickfield, glancing helplessly and distractedly at his partner, ‘that I did doubt her, and think her wanting in her duty to you; and that I did sometimes, if I must say all, feel averse to Agnes being in such a familiar relation towards her, as to see what I saw, or in my diseased theory fancied that I saw. I never mentioned this to anyone. I never meant it to be known to anyone. And though it is terrible to you to hear,’ said Mr. Wickfield, quite subdued, ‘if you knew how terrible it is for me to tell, you would feel compassion for me!’", "sha256": "837c5c2d662aafc61569e33d54633d60f9f71c12be3b510a11d0dbcaba167966", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[103]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0104", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The Doctor, in the perfect goodness of his nature, put out his hand. Mr. Wickfield held it for a little while in his, with his head bowed down.", "sha256": "fff89a9402e834cbeb049713f6408c3dd3b84170b23435bf40ce2446fa9eb003", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[104]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0105", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am sure,’ said Uriah, writhing himself into the silence like a Conger-eel, ‘that this is a subject full of unpleasantness to everybody. But since we have got so far, I ought to take the liberty of mentioning that Copperfield has noticed it too.’", "sha256": "718903506b4f19e8d69c16b39943028f4161a0b6a0ee4f35da8391bd8d56199f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[105]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0106", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I turned upon him, and asked him how he dared refer to me!", "sha256": "a5488aa1b147bc8725d61333fd8984e674a5e9c25c0e42eb1822403401f689fb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[106]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0107", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh! it’s very kind of you, Copperfield,’ returned Uriah, undulating all over, ‘and we all know what an amiable character yours is; but you know that the moment I spoke to you the other night, you knew what I meant. You know you knew what I meant, Copperfield. Don’t deny it! You deny it with the best intentions; but don’t do it, Copperfield.’", "sha256": "d2d5570527044621225d6c941847a64d17e7afe3adb24ab0ba6e2d412565b702", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[107]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0108", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I saw the mild eye of the good old Doctor turned upon me for a moment, and I felt that the confession of my old misgivings and remembrances was too plainly written in my face to be overlooked. It was of no use raging. I could not undo that. Say what I would, I could not unsay it.", "sha256": "f161fbf1694abd3c0fcbd8c573d75309e70e9ef189017f5aa0d259c94888359e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[108]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0109", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We were silent again, and remained so, until the Doctor rose and walked twice or thrice across the room. Presently he returned to where his chair stood; and, leaning on the back of it, and occasionally putting his handkerchief to his eyes, with a simple honesty that did him more honour, to my thinking, than any disguise he could have effected, said:", "sha256": "640c38f476f739a9035190d6b6a7c6c48821070be204cdf14b845559425f500b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[109]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0110", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I have been much to blame. I believe I have been very much to blame. I have exposed one whom I hold in my heart, to trials and aspersions—I call them aspersions, even to have been conceived in anybody’s inmost mind—of which she never, but for me, could have been the object.’", "sha256": "031332eaa394c5a991ea7dd4ed48efc7adc2fa12573afdf6482a8a1cf0d990f8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[110]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0111", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Uriah Heep gave a kind of snivel. I think to express sympathy.", "sha256": "4f1e57dbde9425dbe74a57ee5b6014f05ce83d3166a75f0d38ed3c5955160ab9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[111]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0112", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Of which my Annie,’ said the Doctor, ‘never, but for me, could have been the object. Gentlemen, I am old now, as you know; I do not feel, tonight, that I have much to live for. But my life—my Life—upon the truth and honour of the dear lady who has been the subject of this conversation!’", "sha256": "40d43a5e5b20d6244c1e9f501a0e8ff24bb8d27b72bcf86f58648999d9375a4f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[112]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0113", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I do not think that the best embodiment of chivalry, the realization of the handsomest and most romantic figure ever imagined by painter, could have said this, with a more impressive and affecting dignity than the plain old Doctor did.", "sha256": "925332bdb0f030c0e14f5f89f1ae1c9d954d0a6bbd54557084b46e10178b744a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[113]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0114", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But I am not prepared,’ he went on, ‘to deny—perhaps I may have been, without knowing it, in some degree prepared to admit—that I may have unwittingly ensnared that lady into an unhappy marriage. I am a man quite unaccustomed to observe; and I cannot but believe that the observation of several people, of different ages and positions, all too plainly tending in one direction (and that so natural), is better than mine.’", "sha256": "7c4f9471b4aee06d78255a41b45f4e3170c8daca1a108ac87e4cff65d703810e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[114]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0115", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I had often admired, as I have elsewhere described, his benignant manner towards his youthful wife; but the respectful tenderness he manifested in every reference to her on this occasion, and the almost reverential manner in which he put away from him the lightest doubt of her integrity, exalted him, in my eyes, beyond description.", "sha256": "19bed38e4622f3ad37bcd9ed0d9b35dc5809ee889ee47c4db79dfdfe3e62007e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[115]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0116", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I married that lady,’ said the Doctor, ‘when she was extremely young. I took her to myself when her character was scarcely formed. So far as it was developed, it had been my happiness to form it. I knew her father well. I knew her well. I had taught her what I could, for the love of all her beautiful and virtuous qualities. If I did her wrong; as I fear I did, in taking advantage (but I never meant it) of her gratitude and her affection; I ask pardon of that lady, in my heart!’", "sha256": "472b407949b647748b77a4604953c20483a4fefa5c46d1efa29cb37cae619508", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[116]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0117", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He walked across the room, and came back to the same place; holding the chair with a grasp that trembled, like his subdued voice, in its earnestness.", "sha256": "9f606e99b5dfbf6a20ac5537a06e0aef5c2425a01c0a7093ded0fe9d0a7440b9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[117]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0118", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I regarded myself as a refuge, for her, from the dangers and vicissitudes of life. I persuaded myself that, unequal though we were in years, she would live tranquilly and contentedly with me. I did not shut out of my consideration the time when I should leave her free, and still young and still beautiful, but with her judgement more matured—no, gentlemen—upon my truth!’", "sha256": "fe0a970d4cfc3efe615caf1c702001d88832331c4ecff7b6ba6fcc4e847c41a2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[118]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0119", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "His homely figure seemed to be lightened up by his fidelity and generosity. Every word he uttered had a force that no other grace could have imparted to it.", "sha256": "a2c6e50df84e380721a199fce2e8525e12322ee3f6dd9fd365a9205af676a8b4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[119]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0120", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My life with this lady has been very happy. Until tonight, I have had uninterrupted occasion to bless the day on which I did her great injustice.’", "sha256": "96563372150dfb1dfb4f85cab555a5cee145c38cb17e0e14ebc8e6f97f507aec", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[120]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0121", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "His voice, more and more faltering in the utterance of these words, stopped for a few moments; then he went on:", "sha256": "ac3c9f8bd5696e054c12296678d648232edc2e588828fe556e3309570b938302", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[121]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0122", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Once awakened from my dream—I have been a poor dreamer, in one way or other, all my life—I see how natural it is that she should have some regretful feeling towards her old companion and her equal. That she does regard him with some innocent regret, with some blameless thoughts of what might have been, but for me, is, I fear, too true. Much that I have seen, but not noted, has come back upon me with new meaning, during this last trying hour. But, beyond this, gentlemen, the dear lady’s name never must be coupled with a word, a breath, of doubt.’", "sha256": "fd1949fc783b32fbfd2b678c359843d1ecbd2e93ae1c539a7e75c66dccb362ba", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[122]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0123", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "For a little while, his eye kindled and his voice was firm; for a little while he was again silent. Presently, he proceeded as before:", "sha256": "5ba9f1dbb347f495218c1868801262562997ff27db7cfb1ab0914b76e7f2bfc7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[123]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0124", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It only remains for me, to bear the knowledge of the unhappiness I have occasioned, as submissively as I can. It is she who should reproach; not I. To save her from misconstruction, cruel misconstruction, that even my friends have not been able to avoid, becomes my duty. The more retired we live, the better I shall discharge it. And when the time comes—may it come soon, if it be His merciful pleasure!—when my death shall release her from constraint, I shall close my eyes upon her honoured face, with unbounded confidence and love; and leave her, with no sorrow then, to happier and brighter days.’", "sha256": "ce49a083e5192baa240456ef2b6653b19c968f4aec210574eeb0150b2ced921c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[124]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0125", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I could not see him for the tears which his earnestness and goodness, so adorned by, and so adorning, the perfect simplicity of his manner, brought into my eyes. He had moved to the door, when he added:", "sha256": "3c99ab3acc837edcb5d8bd4efd47cf820fbc714932ac83977ebc0b1ff2383052", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[125]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0126", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Gentlemen, I have shown you my heart. I am sure you will respect it. What we have said tonight is never to be said more. Wickfield, give me an old friend’s arm upstairs!’", "sha256": "868e41e1385c7574b14b9dfedb91a4e515d1f59aa1fcd40f3cd05bcef5573766", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[126]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0127", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Wickfield hastened to him. Without interchanging a word they went slowly out of the room together, Uriah looking after them.", "sha256": "69d4f382ec9ccb0bde5be1f310f4ae6d94654fd38bd864b50899cb8f53788f89", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[127]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
